'''R4-P17''', nicknamed '''R4''', or '''Arfour''', was the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] attached to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class starfighter]] and was often on board his [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class starfighter]] and [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class light interceptor]] prior to and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
{{Quote|Arfour, be careful! You have a&mdash;|Obi-Wan Kenobi warns R4 just before her destruction|<ref name="RotS" />}}
The droid originally possessed the [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4-series's]] trademark conical head dome but was involved in a messy incident while trying to repair a trash compactor on [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]], resulting in the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] being crushed. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], on a visit to the shipyards to inspect the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] customization to the Delta-7, found R4's wreck and rebuilt her with an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series]] dome.<ref name="DB" /> From that point on the communal property of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], R4 became the prototype for other [[R4-P astromech droid|integrated droid navigators]] in Jedi ships. As part of the Delta-7, the astromech had a truncated body, which was, after her destruction, permanently attached to the ship.

[[File:R4-P17_zaps_Jawa.png|thumb|left|220px|R4-P17 defends Obi-Wan Kenobi's [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] from [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]].]]
Prior to the Clone Wars, she helped Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to follow [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] from [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. The fighter that she was in was recovered after or during the battle that took place later.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Jedi began to transition away from the Delta-7. R4 was given a full astromech body, white, with red trim, to make her compatible with the new Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class interceptor and Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor used by [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] Kenobi. However, before she received her full body, Obi-Wan temporarily used a droid called [[R4-G9/Legends|R4-G9]].<ref name="CharEnc" /> After he switched back to R4-P17, Obi-Wan requisitioned a direct link between the two droids to ensure all flight performance records could be transferred between them.

R4 was present on [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], 7 [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]<ref name="Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref><ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> and standing in the droid socket of Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor when he got into the fighter to travel to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in order to negotiate with [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. R4 accompanied him there and participated in the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]], piloting the starfighter after Kenobi jumped from it to fight in the battle on the ground.<ref name="TCW film">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> Later on in the war, she was present in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] before traveling to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] to stop the bounty hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] from kidnapping [[Wee Dunn/Legends|Wee Dunn]],<ref name="Children of the Force>{{TCW|Children of the Force}}</ref> and to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] when Kenobi was investigating rumors of the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] creating an army for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="The Mandalore Plot">{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}</ref> She also fought in the [[Battle of Sullust/Legends|Battle of Sullust]], during which [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], piloting her [[Ginivex-class starfighter/Legends|Ginivex-class starfighter]], shot Obi-Wan Kenobi's starfighter. He landed the ship, which caught on fire near the droid socket in which R4 was located, in the hangar of a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|Providence-class carrier/destroyer]]. Anakin Skywalker helped Obi-Wan Kenobi get out of the ship and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] extinguished the fire on it. The battle continued, ending with a Separatist withdrawal.<ref name="Nightsisters">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref>

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="Date Legends">{{TCWdates|611}}</ref>, R4 and [[R4-M1/Legends|R4-M1]] were present in one of the corridors of the Jedi Temple when General Kenobi and General [[Mace Windu|Windu]] were talking about [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].<ref name="Voices">{{TCW|Voices}}</ref>

R4-P17 later suffered extreme damage due to her dome being pulled apart by a [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|buzz droid]] attack in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] while aboard Kenobi's Eta-2. The remains of the droid were lost when the rear half of [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] was severed while Skywalker and Kenobi tried to land the damaged [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]].<ref name="RotS" />

Obi-Wan lamented the loss of R4-P17, as the droid had been a competent unit. He was soon after assigned [[R4-G9/Legends|R4-G9]], who had served as his interim astromech during the later stages of the Clone Wars.

==Personality and traits==
R4 was an R4-series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton<ref name="CharEnc">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>, who, after being refitted, had a height of 0.96 meters<ref name="DB">{{DB|droid|r4p17|R4-P17}}</ref><ref name="CharEnc" />. She had a red dome.<ref name="Episode 2" /> R4 was courageous and had great reflexes, quickly defending herself and Obi-Wan Kenobi's starfighter when Jawas wanted to attack her.<ref name="TCW film" /> These qualities were also evident during the [[Dogfight over Geonosis/Legends|fight]] against [[Slave I/Legends|Slave I]], the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]] and the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].<ref name="Episode 2" /><ref name="TCW film" /><ref name="RotS" />.

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|R4, prepare to jettison spare part canisters.|Obi-Wan Kenobi to R4-P17|<ref name="Episode 2" />}}
R4 could calculate [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]] jumps, having been designed to qualify as a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] navigator.<ref name="CharEnc" /> She was also very skilled in repair and maintenance<ref name="CharEnc" /> and a great starfighter pilot.<ref name="Episode 2" /><ref name="TCW film" /><ref name="RotS" />

==Equipment==
R4 had an electro-shock prod, which she used to protect Kenobi's starfighter from [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] during a visit to Jabba's Palace.<ref name="TCW film" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the novelization of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Attack of the Clones'']], Boba and Jango Fett are able to recognize R4-P17 as an R4-P class droid. However, since the droid had the turret dome of an R2 unit, and since only her head was visible, the Fetts would not have been able to guess its true class.

[[File:R4-P17_Buzz_Droids.png|thumb|200px|R4-P17 during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].]]
In the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Revenge of the Sith'' novel]], R4-P17 is described as being partially crippled by a cannon shot from a [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid fighter]] before her destruction, which in turn is not described in detail, other than the fact that Anakin Skywalker witnessed it.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> Moreover, at some points in the actual movie R4-P17's body appears red with a white trim.<ref name="RotS" />

In ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]'' and ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]'', R4-P17 is a playable character. In this game, she accompanies [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] into [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]]; this change was made to enable the two-player drop-in/ drop-out co-op functionality created for the game. However, R4-P17's dome in the game does not feature a mostly red color scheme; instead, it has a color scheme similar to that of [[R2-M5/Legends|R2-M5]]. This essentially complies with the [[2002]] Jedi Starfighter model, which features R4-P17 in this color.

In the Gameboy Advance version of the game, R4 also accompanies Kenobi to Utapau, even though, in the official canon, she was destroyed during the Battle of Coruscant and replaced by R4-G9. In order to ensure co-op mode, she helps Kenobi fight Grievous. This was most likely done to avoid confusion, as the game was primarily geared towards a younger audience.

In ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'', R4-P17's head is correctly colored, but the droid's body is entirely red.

George Lucas decided that R4-P17 was of feminine programming as she was primarily operated by female droid operator [[Zeynep Selcuk|Zeynup "Zed" Selcuk]].<ref name="DB" />
